Pakistani Man Apprehended Attempting LoC Infiltration in Poonch

A Pakistani man was arrested while allegedly attempting to infiltrate across the Line of Control (LoC) in Poonch. He is currently undergoing questioning by a joint team comprising the Army, police, and intelligence agencies. The incident occurred in the Poonch sector, where such infiltration attempts are a recurring security concern. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding his apprehension.
